full_page.content:
1945, August 31
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten message on a Seraphic Mass Association card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Denis and Mary Molloy -- for God's holy guidance -- - each -
August 31st, 1945 God speed your hopes and plans. - Love - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
( Requested by ) Mrs. Mary C. Molloy
Pl. pray I catch up with my letters, etc. God's blessing to all at 124 Warren and all.
Original in possession of : Mrs. Mary C. Molloy 1327 Lincoln Avenue, #213 San Rafael, California 94901
(Mary Casey Molloy, daughter of James Casey)
